text:
Colin Blackwell is a fourth-line forward for the Stars, playing about ten minutes a night, and the scoresheet has been empty: no goals and one assist in 15 games. He hasn't played since Nov 17.

The on-ice numbers are the tough part. Dallas gets 42% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, nearly ten points worse than without him. Evolving-Hockey had a similar note last season: his team created very little with him on.

He's a seventh-round pick from 2011 who has played for six NHL teams, which says a lot about how hard he works to stay in the league. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found one signature: 29% of his setups came from behind the net, against 8% for a typical forward.

The Stars have been winning around him, and with Joel Kiviranta back in the lineup, his spot is less secure. What to watch: whether he returns to the lineup or becomes the extra forward. With 33 hits in 15 games, he does bring the energy.
